scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n sdk,api,web "npm run dev -w @bugradar/browser-sdk" "npm run dev -w @bugradar/api" "npm run dev -w @bugradar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bugradar/browser-sdk && npm run build -w @bugradar/nestjs-sdk && npm run build -w @bugradar/api && npm run build -w @bugradar/nest-demo && npm run build -w @bugradar/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @bugradar/browser-sdk && npm run build -w @bugradar/api && node --env-file=apps/api/.env --import tsx apps/api/test/integration.ts
scripts.test:server: npm run build -w @bugradar/nestjs-sdk && npm run build -w @bugradar/api && npm run build -w @bugradar/nest-demo && node --env-file=apps/api/.env --import tsx apps/api/test/server-integration.ts
scripts.test:audit: npm run build -w @bugradar/api && node --env-file=apps/api/.env --import tsx apps/api/test/functional-audit.ts
